thread:
alex: Heads-up — kickoff for BigFin POC tomorrow 11am PT. They want the streaming SDK + function-calls + structured JSON outputs (annotations) into their ticketing system. Need engineering to confirm schema compatibility and a quick note for the security questionnaire.

maria: Thanks. Can someone from eng join the call? They want to test live streaming with long docs and function-call hooks.

pat: Quick pricing Q — if we run this on hosted vs dedicated, what rough delta should I tell procurement?

sophia: For initial POC (low qps) hosted is fine. If they plan parallel realtime workers (>=10 concurrent streaming sessions) recommend Dedicated reserved pool — roughly 3-4x unit cost for predictable throughput. I'll DM numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

alex: Also security questionnaire: Q12 about retention & access controls. We should confirm defaults (no transcript retention unless customer opts in) and KMS for keys.

jordan: Eng note: for function-calls we should send them our minimal schema. They want annotations like {'page': int, 'bbox': [x,y,w,h], 'label': string, 'score': float}. Any concerns?

pat: That schema seems fine. How do we stream partial annotations while keeping ordering? Their downstream requires idempotency keys.

alex: We can include message_id + chunk_index. Keep function call per chunk:
```
{'name':'annotate_page',
 'arguments':{
   'message_id':'uuid',
   'chunk_index':3,
   'annotations':[{'page':1, 'bbox':[0,0,200,300], 'label':'fraud', 'score':0.92}]
 }
}
```

sophia: @jordan can you confirm SDK sample? We should give them both streaming + fallback batch snippet.

jordan: Sample (JS streaming):
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rflx-stream-1', input: docStream });
for await (const evt of stream) {
  if (evt.type === 'function_call') callHandler(evt.payload);
  if (evt.type === 'partial_output') buffer.push(evt.text);
}
```
They can call our function-calling API whenever a chunk is ready.

pat: Security question: can we provide an ATO-style summary for data flow? They need VPC peering + private endpoints.

maria: Yes — Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering is available. Need to confirm whether customer requires on-prem HSM.

eng-ops-bot: CI preview for sample app deployed at https://staging.redwood.example/poc-bigfin — logs accessible to invited users.

jordan: On the token limits: long documents may hit context window. Recommend client-side chunking at ~4k tokens and incremental KV caching on our side. We'll provide a helper util.

alex: Can someone paste a one-paragraph summary for tomorrow's call (technical bullets + blockers)? I'll add to the calendar invite.

sophia: Summary: 1) Goal: POC to ingest PDFs, stream token-level annotations into BigFin case system using function-calls and structured JSON. 2) Blockers: confirm schema/idempotency, VPC peering + private endpoints, retention policy answers for security questionnaire, and performance for long docs (we'll recommend client chunking + Dedicated for scale). 3) Ask: Eng to join to validate SDK flow and run quick end-to-end test.

pat: I'll prep a pricing slide and the security Q answers draft. Who wants to join the call 11am PT?

jordan: I'll join and bring the SDK snippets + a tiny sample app to demo streaming -> function_call -> webhook.

maria: Great, adding jordan + alex + sophia. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

alex: Perfect — thanks everyone. If any urgent blockers surface ping me here.
